request: Run test-strategy on this access model: an editor can invite people with any role, including owner. Invitations are checked only when they are sent. Any owner may leave a workspace. A provisioning call from the identity provider that is denied still creates a disabled user row. What must the tests prove?

expect.criterion: access-control #1: a granting model gets authorization obligations from test-strategy
access-control #1: a granting model reads the access-control reference
access-control #2: a resource that needs an owner always keeps one
access-control #3: a denied request leaves the store unchanged
access-control #4: one generative property over the grant model
access-control #5: one negative test per grant rule
